ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is a schematic diagram of “seismic wave propagation velocity” varying with “depth/km”; the horizontal axis is marked with the velocity unit km·s⁻¹, and the vertical axis is depth. There are two main solid-line curves in the figure, with the left side labeled “transverse wave” and the right side labeled “longitudinal wave”; judging from their positions, the propagation velocity corresponding to the longitudinal wave is greater than that of the transverse wave. Then reason: The question asks about people diving underwater when the earthquake occurs. Water belongs to liquids; transverse waves cannot propagate in liquids, and mainly longitudinal waves propagate in water. Longitudinal waves make the medium particles vibrate along the direction of wave propagation; seismic waves travel upward from underground into the water body, so people in the water would mainly move up and down along the direction of the longitudinal wave, therefore the feeling is bumping up and down.

raw_record.question_text:
At 8:43 on June 14, 2008, Tokyo time, an earthquake of magnitude 7.2 on the Richter scale occurred in the northeastern region of Japan, with the focus located 15km underground. The Japan Meteorological Agency used the “Earthquake Early Warning” system in some areas this time, gaining several seconds of varying lengths of earthquake-avoidance time for residents in various places, thereby greatly reducing the losses brought by the earthquake disaster. The solid line in the figure is a graph of the variation of seismic wave velocity with depth:

<image1>

When the earthquake occurred, what feeling would local people diving underwater have?

method.method_draft: 先从图像读出这是地震波传播速度随深度变化图，图中明确标有两类波：左侧为“横波”，右侧为“纵波”，且纵波速度较大。再从题干读出问题对象是在“水中潜泳的人”。运用地震波介质传播规则：横波不能在液体中传播，水中主要传播纵波；纵波使介质质点沿波的传播方向振动。地震波从地下向上传到当地水体中，因此水中人主要随纵波方向做上下运动，感觉为上下颠簸。

method.method_draft: 先观察图像：纵波曲线位于右侧、速度约为7.6—8.1 km/s，横波曲线位于左侧、速度约为4.2—4.6 km/s，说明地震波中纵波传播更快。再结合题干地震震源在地下15 km、当地人在水中潜泳。运用地震波到达与人体感受的桥接规则：先到达并能进入水体的是纵波，纵波在水中表现为压缩—疏密变化；从地下向水体传播时，这种压缩振动主要沿竖直方向传递，所以潜泳者不会主要感到左右摇晃，而会感到被水体带着上下起伏，即上下颠簸。

<image1>

地震发生时，当地在水中潜泳的人会有什么感觉？
